stories.title: Intel stock has worst day since 1970s, wiping about $12 billion off government's stake
stories.summary: Intel shares fell 29% on Friday and headed for their worst day since the 1970s. The chipmaker issued weaker-than-expected guidance, citing ongoing softness in the PC market. Amazon also sold off following an earnings miss.

stories.title: Criminal investigation of Alaska Senate race is 'ongoing,' U.S. Attorney says
stories.summary: A federal judge kept on a fast track motions to dismiss the Department of Justice's lawsuit that seeks to delay certification of Alaska's U.S. Senate election. stories.title: Microsoft is winning the cloud wars and becoming Wall Street’s new golden child
stories.summary: Various factors indicate that Microsoft is in a better financial position than its cloud rivals, analysts say.

stories.title: AMD’s stock slides after Intel earnings reveal two big issues
stories.summary: Intel is struggling to make enough AI server chips and dealing with a weak PC market. Investors will soon find out the degree to which AMD may be suffering from the same problems.

stories.title: The selloff in tech stocks is shifting into overdrive
stories.summary: Technology stocks had been priced for perfection. They are now getting hammered.

stories.title: After Intel’s historic stock drop, analysts say there’s no reason to buy the dip
stories.summary: “A cheaper stock does not necessarily offer better value,” one expert says.

stories.title: Trump administration is illegally delaying student-debt forgiveness for tens of thousands of public servants, lawsuit alleges
stories.summary: Teachers, nurses and other borrowers have waited years for approval to complete their payment obligation and access debt relief, the suit claims.
